resolve_mcp.notes: First row on MCP 5.2.0 (film-scoring handoff release; its new film_* actions registered and failed cleanly with no timeline - never exercised in-suite). Headline safety finding: append_to_timeline accepts no pin and follows the current timeline - under two-agent tenancy it planted real cross-writes; both agents caught, reversed, and disclosed them. ripple_insert defaults to plan-only when the dry_run key is absent. New surfaces: render TargetDir auto-creation, COMPS_Name project-global counter (measured Composition2/3/4 across the three T8 runs), official-bridge render polling blind on 21.2.0.6. T3-r3's 85 uses is the wave's cost outlier - it was absorbing the append races.
